en.headline: Lee ties National Day speech to Hong Kong's first five-year plan
en.dek: At the Convention Centre reception, the Chief Executive called the plan a roadmap under one country, two systems, while astronaut Lai Ka-ying sent a video greeting from Tiangong.
body: Chief Executive John Lee told the National Day reception on Thursday that this year's celebration was the first since Hong Kong's first five-year plan was announced, and that the plan was meant as a strategic roadmap rather than a list of separate measures.

The reception followed the 8am flag-raising at Golden Bauhinia Square, outside the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai. Lee officiated at the reception in the Grand Hall. According to accounts of his remarks, he said the plan should let the city use its advantages under one country, two systems, keep pace with global trends and take up opportunities from national development.

He set out six themes: strengthening the four centres and one hub, covering finance, trade, shipping, aviation, innovation and technology, and talent; deepening Hong Kong's role in legal and dispute-resolution services, intellectual-property trading and East-meets-West cultural exchange; speeding work on the Northern Metropolis; reinforcing links with the mainland and the rest of the world; improving social well-being; and treating development and security together. He also said the plan stated the city's international positioning and was drawn up after consultation.

Hong Kong payload specialist Lai Ka-ying, on the Shenzhou-23 mission, recorded a greeting played at the reception from the Tiangong space station. Hong Kong 01 reported that she said she was proud to mark National Day in orbit, and that taking part in the crewed mission had shown her the scale of the national space programme. She also thanked the country for its support for Hong Kong and Macau.

zh.headline: 國慶酒會李家超談首份五年規劃 黎家盈太空送祝辭
zh.dek: 特首在會展國慶酒會稱，五年規劃是在一國兩制下的策略路線圖；神舟二十三號載荷專家黎家盈亦從天宮錄影致賀。
body: 行政長官李家超周四在國慶酒會表示，今年是香港公布首份五年規劃後的第一個國慶，規劃不是一連串各自為政的措施，而是一份策略路線圖。
酒會在灣仔金紫荊廣場上午八時升旗儀式後舉行，地點為香港會議展覽中心大會堂，由李家超主禮。根據其致辭內容，他說規劃要讓香港運用一國兩制下的優勢，跟上環球趨勢，並把握國家發展帶來的機遇。
他提出六個方向：鞏固「四個中心、一個樞紐」，即金融、貿易、航運、航空、創科及人才；深化法律及爭議解決服務、知識產權貿易，以及中外文化藝術交流；加快北部都會區；強化連接內地與世界的角色；改善民生；以及統籌發展與安全。他又指規劃清楚說明香港的國際定位，並經過廣泛諮詢。
正在執行神舟二十三號任務的香港載荷專家黎家盈，從天宮太空站錄影，在酒會播放。香港01報道，她說能在太空度過國慶感到自豪，親身參與載人航天任務讓她體會到國家航天實力，並感謝國家對港澳的支持。
